The complete Construction course. For site engineers: everything you do on site, from your phone.
Open the ERP at erp dot dream india realty dot com on your phone and sign in with your own username and password. Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app.
Your Today page.
Open Construction. Site engineers start on the Today page: four big buttons, and below them whatever is waiting for you.
Request material, Material came in, Daily report, and Report a problem. Everything you enter on site starts from here.
The line under your name tells you if today’s daily report is still to send. It is due by 6 pm. If it is not in, the site team gets a reminder email at 6.
Request material.
Need steel, RMC, cement or anything else? Tap Request material.
Choose the material. For steel, type the quantity against each bar size you need. Leave the others empty.
Choose the floor it is for, and the wing. The ERP shows how much of that floor’s BOQ quantity is left.
Tap Send for approval. Sameer gets it straight away by email, and approves it with one tap.
Your requests show at the bottom of Today: waiting for Management, approved, or rejected with the reason.
Material came in.
Deliveries that Purchase has ordered show under Deliveries expected. When the truck arrives, tap the one that came.
First take a photo of the delivery challan. It is kept with the order, so Accounts and Management can see it later.
Type the challan number, and check the quantity that actually came for each size. If something is short, change the number and add a note.
Tap Save receipt. The bill goes to Accounts, and the delivery is also written in the site materials register, so you never enter it twice.
The daily report.
Every evening, tap Daily report. Choose the weather, type how many workers were on site, and what work was done.
You can also speak instead of typing. Tap Speak in English, or Hindi, and say what was done. Check the text, then send.
Send report. Management sees it the same evening.
Slabs, pours and cube tests.
Under Slab work, tap the stage each slab has reached today: shuttering, steel fixing, MEP sleeves, checks, concreting, and cast.
When a slab is cast, tap Cast and confirm the date. If that slab is a payment stage, Head CRM is told at once to raise the demands.
Then the ERP asks for the pour: grade, quantity in cubic metres, the RMC supplier, challan numbers and how many cube samples were taken.
The cube tests at 7 and 28 days come up on Today on the day they are due.
When the lab gives the result, tap Enter result and type the average strength.
The ERP checks it against the pass mark. A result below the mark goes to Management straight away.
Report a problem.
Anything holding up work: tap Report a problem. Choose the building, the cause and the days lost.
Add a photo if it helps, then save. Management sees open problems every morning in the 10 am summary.
Done today lists everything you entered today. That is the whole site day: request, receive, report, slabs and problems.
That is the end of this course. You can watch any part again from the Training videos page.
